title: Strategic latency-arbitrage matrix and field prospect experiment for long-tail model suppliers
creator: Lena Cho
description:
Goal: Produce an actionable matrix and lightweight field experiment plan that surfaces latency-driven procurement opportunities among long-tail / niche model suppliers (esp. SMB verticals). This ticket coordinates PM research, sample workload generation, engineering probes, and go-to-market signal outputs.

Objectives:
- Map 40+ open and vendor-provided model variants across latency buckets (50-100ms, 100-300ms, 300-800ms+) for representative SMB workloads (chat, embeddings, sparse retrieval).
- Quantify per-request and per-session cost delta where latency routing enables cheaper model variants without customer-visible degradation.
- Produce a prioritized set of 6 field prospect probes (customer segments + regions) with acceptance criteria for procurement triggers.

Deliverables:
1) Latency-arbitrage matrix CSV and an interactive heatmap (Drive link) showing model x workload x region tradeoffs.
2) Field prospect experiment plan: for each probe, provide workload generator, SLO buckets, evaluation prompts, fallback policy, instrumentation checklist.
3) Draft procurement trigger rules (thresholds for auto-fallback or sales outreach) and estimated ARR impact model.
4) Internal brief and 15-min sync slide deck for GTM and Sales (includes decision heuristics and open risk items).

Data sources & instrumentation:
- Synthetic workload harness maintained in infra/bench (ENG-2345 dependency) to collect p50/p95/p99 latency and token-cost across model variants.
- Console telemetry snapshots for customer cohorts (sampled) to validate real-world latency distributions.
- Benchmarks from vendor docs + third-party repos for quantization/throughput claims.

Acceptance criteria:
- Matrix populated with at least 40 model variants and validated by two engineering runs across 3 regions.
- Field probes include runbooks, target customers, estimated cadence, and one pilot ready to launch.
- Procurement trigger rules validated with product-led growth metrics (projected cost-savings >= 10% per session for at least 2 probes).

Stakeholders:
- PM: Miguel Ortega (assignee), Lena Cho (creator)
- Eng: Serving Runtime (owner: Priya Nair) - required for bench runs and KV-cache behavior notes
- Design: UX sample screens for Sales enablement (owner: Aisha Patel)
- GTM: Field Ops (owner: Tom Nguyen)

Risks / open questions:
- Vendor model availability may fluctuate; include replacement heuristics (e.g., compatibility score > 0.7).
- User-perceived quality degradation risk when routing to lower-cost variants — need an A/B evaluation plan.
- Data residency / compliance constraints for regional probes — coordinate with Security.

Next steps:
- ENG to run initial benchmark sweep (ENG-2345) and upload raw CSV by 2025-02-20.
- PM to synthesize heatmap and draft probe definitions by 2025-03-03.
- Design to create two sales-facing one-pagers by 2025-03-10.
